This page has every prediction I made with the criteria I use for resolving predictions, as well as some short notes for/against each prediction. See the [predictions page](index.qmd) for the general summary. You can sort by clicking column headers. Remember, these are both my assessment of the general probabilities, and then my personal confidence in my own analysis, which I call *effort.* This should serve as a pseudo-weight on how much I would actually stand behind a call or be open to updating. A **quick take** is something I'm making on vibes or a gut check, **considered** generally means some amount of rough BOTECs without modeling, and **deep dives** are things I base on original analysis or modeling.
